basic_info.description: 1719 43rd Ave | Outer Sunset  Bright coastal living blocks to Ocean Beach with ocean views from the main living/dining and the full-floor primary suite. Thoughtful 3-level plan: Main level has living/dining, modern kitchen, bedroom with en-suite, and a second bedroom- ideal as a cozy sleeping space or even home office. A landing-level full bath functions as the guest powder. Upper level is an ocean-view primary suite. Lower level offers interior garage access (storage), laundry room, 4rd bedroom or large flex room (media/guest/gym), plus an additional office  (2nd office or streamlined storage). Outside: new front landscaping and a sunny backyard with turf & sustainable plantings. Gated driveway + garage parking. Near GGP, Noriega/Judah favorites, and the N-Judah. *Home staged as 3 bedrooms plus a guest suite, buyer to verify legal bedroom count to their own satisfaction
